SELECT ID, TEST_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, PRIORITY, STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as CREATED_AT, ASSIGNEE, FIX_DUE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(FIXED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as FIXED_DATE, REMARKS, IS_DELETED, DATE_FORMAT(UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as UPDATED_AT, PJTID, AUTO_GENERATED FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM TB_DEFECT
ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}

SELECT ID, TEST_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, PRIORITY, STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as CREATED_AT, ASSIGNEE, FIX_DUE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(FIXED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as FIXED_DATE, REMARKS, IS_DELETED, DATE_FORMAT(UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as UPDATED_AT, PJTID, AUTO_GENERATED FROM TB_DEFECT WHERE ID = #{id} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DEFECT ( ID, TEST_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, PRIORITY, STATUS, CREATED_AT, ASSIGNEE, FIX_DUE_DATE, FIXED_DATE, REMARKS, IS_DELETED, UPDATED_AT, PJTID, AUTO_GENERATED ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{testId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, NOW(), #{assignee}, #{fixDueDate}, #{fixedDate}, #{remarks}, COALESCE(#{isDeleted}, 'N'), NOW(), #{pjtid}, COALESCE(#{autoGenerated}, 'N') )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DEFECT SET NAME = #{name}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PRIORITY = #{priority}, STATUS = #{status}, ASSIGNEE = #{assignee}, FIX_DUE_DATE = #{fixDueDate}, FIXED_DATE = #{fixedDate}, REMARKS = #{remarks}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE ID = #{id} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
UPDATE TB_DEFECT SET IS_DELETED = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, TEST_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, PRIORITY, STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as CREATED_AT, ASSIGNEE, FIX_DUE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(FIXED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as FIXED_DATE, REMARKS, IS_DELETED, DATE_FORMAT(UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as UPDATED_AT, PJTID, AUTO_GENERATED FROM TB_DEFECT WHERE TEST_ID = #{testId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DEFECT SET FIXED_DATE = NOW(), UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE ID = #{id} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DEFECT_STATUS_HISTORY ( ID, DEFECT_ID, STATUS, CHANGED_AT, CHANGED_BY, REMARKS ) VALUES ( CONCAT('DSH_', LPAD((SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ID, 5) AS UNSIGNED)) + 1 FROM TB_DEFECT_STATUS_HISTORY), 8, '0')), #{id}, #{status}, NOW(), #{assignee}, #{remarks} )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ID, 5) AS UNSIGNED)) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ID, 5) AS UNSIGNED)) + 1 END as nextSequence FROM TB_DEFECT WHERE ID REGEXP '^DEF_[0-9]{3}$' AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
